items.source: beanName - the name of the bean when it is created in this context. The name can be null if we are autowiring a bean which doesn't belong to the factory.
items.translation: `beanName` - 该 Bean 在此上下文中创建时的名称。如果正在自动装配不属于工厂的 Bean，则该名称可以为 `null`。

items.source: bd - the bean definition
items.translation: bd - 该 Bean 定义

items.source: owner - the owning BeanFactory
items.translation: owner - 拥有该 BeanFactory 的 BeanFactory

items.source: a bean instance for this bean definition
items.translation: 用于该 Bean 定义的 Bean 实例

items.source:
Does not support Method Injection, although it provides hooks for subclasses
to override to add Method Injection support, for example by overriding methods.
items.translation: 不支持方法注入，尽管它提供了钩子供子类重写以添加方法注入支持，例如通过重写方法。

items.source:
Allows factory method implementations to determine whether the current
caller is the container itself as opposed to user code.
items.translation: 允许工厂方法实现确定当前调用者是容器本身，而不是用户代码。

Return an instance of the bean with the given name in this factory,
creating it via the given factory method.
items.translation: 返回此工厂中给定名称的 Bean 实例，并通过给定的工厂方法创建它。

creating it via the given constructor.

items.source:
Subclasses can override this method, which is implemented to throw
UnsupportedOperationException, if they can instantiate an object with
the Method Injection specified in the given RootBeanDefinition.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，如果它们能够根据给定的 RootBeanDefinition 中指定的方法注入实例化一个对象，则该方法被实现为抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

items.translation: 返回当前正在调用的工厂方法，如果没有则返回null。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this method, which is implemented to throw
UnsupportedOperationException, if they can instantiate an object with
the Method Injection specified in the given RootBeanDefinition.
Instantiation should use a no-arg constructor.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，如果它们能够根据给定的 RootBeanDefinition 中指定的方法注入实例化一个对象，则该方法实现为抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。实例化应使用无参构造函数。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this method, which is implemented to throw
UnsupportedOperationException, if they can instantiate an object with
the Method Injection specified in the given RootBeanDefinition.
Instantiation should use the given constructor and parameters.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，如果它们能够根据给定的 RootBeanDefinition 中指定的方法注入实例化一个对象，则该方法将抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。实例化应使用给定的构造函数和参数。

items.source: factoryBean - the factory bean instance to call the factory method on, or null in case of a static factory method
items.translation: factoryBean - 要调用工厂方法的工厂 Bean 实例，或者在静态工厂方法的情况下为 null。
